column2: Multiple automations, per-business scoped
Drag-and-drop canvas builder
Full execution logs with node-level attribution
Searchable execution history (by workflow, status, date range, run ID)
Live view of running automations
Error containment — a stuck/looping automation can't affect other automations, other businesses, or the platform
Trigger → Filter → (optional AI step) → Action structure
Triggers: message received, message sent, label added, label removed, CRM record created, CRM record changed
Filters: contact-property comparison, existence check
Flow control: Condition/Router (mandatory fallback)
Actions: add/remove label, call webhook, format/manipulate data, Find CRM record, Create CRM record, Update CRM Table, Call CAPI, update session field, fire custom CDP event, AI analysis step
UI Improvements (If any)
Filter/trigger by segment (CDP-based) — leads the CEO's notes, needs his explicit call
Stop / override an outgoing reply (Need Confirmation)
Schedule (cron) trigger
Conversation-inactivity trigger ("chat delay")
Wait/delay step, with re-check on resume
UI Improvements (If any)
Campaign/broadcast delivered or opened trigger
Frequency cap or suppression-list entry reached trigger
Lifecycle/RFM stage changed trigger (e.g. VIP, churn-risk)
Ad platform conversion echoed back into Cekat trigger
Add/remove contact from a segment or list action
Enroll contact into a campaign or broadcast sequence action
Apply or lift a suppression/frequency cap action
Update marketing consent/opt-in status action
